title: ceammc.spat
description: `ceammc.spat` is an index of spatialization objects in the ceammc library, covering 2D and 3D ambisonics, stereo panning, multichannel spatializers, and related HOA processing utilities. Use it to locate specialized objects such as `hoa.2d.encoder~`, `pan.cos~`, or `spat.pan8~` for a particular spatial-audio task.
